decision: Retain the conditional initial AAT formulation/potency/process qualification option at inherited rank7; close this bounded source review without authorizing spend or broader screening.

selection.objective: Expected discounted financial value retained by ddiscov after remaining development, commercial and rights costs, sharing and financing.
selection.selected_uncertainty: Whether a bounded AAT formulation/potency/process qualification can enable an informative usable-graft decision and a commercially retained contribution.
selection.basis: User-selected bounded existing-program review after six closed source passes. Inherited conditional rank7; no broader new-opportunity screening or fresh full-portfolio valuation.

original_cost_row: Initial formulation/potency/process qualification only; scarce organs and transplant validation excluded.

completed_information_updates.finding: Exact recovered rank7 cost row prices initial formulation/potency/process qualification only at US$30–100k/two-to-four months; scarce organs and transplant validation are excluded.
completed_information_updates.impact: Preserve qualification as the original priced action. Do not transfer the P2 human-function budget or impose a completed graft result before informative feasibility.

completed_information_updates.topic: Human study version, unit and missingness
completed_information_updates.finding: A primary2019 author thesis provides eight-pair methods, replenished nominal exposure and incomplete repeated observations;2020/2026 lineage likely overlaps. Full2026 methods remain unverified; patent five-donor provenance is not additive.
completed_information_updates.impact: Narrow feasibility uncertainty without creating independent replication, complete12h denominators or proven transplantability.

completed_information_updates.finding: 2018 cold recombinant-AAT preservation includes a storage-solution rinse with retained graft AAT at4h. Published2023 pig systemic-recipient treatment improves early oxygen recovery;2025 AATD augmentation remains observational with distinct enrollment/comparison sets.
completed_information_updates.impact: Retain early functional support without relabeling it as warm-EVLP-only durable recipient benefit or survival superiority.

completed_information_updates.finding: Nominal added AAT, human-antigen ELISA and functional inhibitory activity differ; pig3mg/mL versus0.5mg/mL antigen remains unexplained. Perfusate replacement, protein/excipients/electrolytes and IV handling limits constrain interpretation.
completed_information_updates.impact: An activity/process qualification is informative. Do not invent a loss fraction, inactive fraction, warm stability specification or clinical safety margin.

completed_information_updates.topic: Product, granted claims and clinical stage
completed_information_updates.finding: AU/KR grant existence was already recorded; this review inspects original granted versions and limitations. US status remains unresolved, Canadian UHN trial remains displayed notyetrecruiting, and approved-IV biological product/platform labeling do not establish an EVLP product route.
completed_information_updates.impact: Price a specific retained contribution rather than assume generic availability, licensed rights, FTO, clinical results or an automatic regulatory pathway.

completed_information_updates.finding: Useful finite-processing protection may involve retained tissue AAT or physical formulation. Dualprotease mechanistic uniqueness, complete drug-free tissue and permanent repair are not universal requirements for a valuable graft outcome.
completed_information_updates.impact: Compare actual clinically useful and practical advantage plus remaining costs and retained economics. Mechanistic claims and stronger repair/durability claims require their own evidence.

routes.title: Initial formulation/potency/process qualification
routes.decision_useful_output: Interpretable active exposure and practical process definition that enable a later relevant graft comparison.
routes.limit: Original illustrative priced tranche; actual scope/feasibility/follow-on cost remain conditional.

routes.title: Paired donor-organ function
routes.decision_useful_output: Useful graft performance against an optimized clinically relevant comparator with donor pairing and missingness preserved.
routes.limit: Scarce organs and this validation stage are outside the initial envelope.

routes.title: Recipient-relevant processing benefit
routes.decision_useful_output: Intended organ-treatment route improves graft use or worthwhile recipient function with acceptable carryover and workflow.
routes.limit: Systemic recipient treatment is not substitutable; retained local protection may be useful.

routes.title: Commercially retained contribution
routes.decision_useful_output: Differentiated formulation/process or contracted usable data/service contribution with acceptable development and sharing economics.
routes.limit: No secured supply, access, license, FTO, quote or regulatory route established.

routes.title: Wait or stop
routes.decision_useful_output: Preserve capital when an action is uninformative or its continuation is unattractive.
routes.limit: Source closure does not automatically demote the candidate or authorize repetitive review.

branches.decision: Compare finite informative qualification and its enabling value. Failed formulation or recovery assay is not biological target failure.
Consider a separately priced organ/recipient stage; no automatic larger spend or clinical efficacy claim.

branches.condition: Physical matching removes the AAT-specific increment
branches.decision: Reduce protein-specific advantage; a practical formulation may still matter if useful outcomes and retained contribution exist.

branches.condition: Simpler comparator has similar useful outcomes
branches.decision: Compare totalcost/handling/exposure/safety/workflow; no unique dualNEPR3 gate and no nonsignificance-as-equivalence.

branches.condition: Intended processing improves meaningful graft or recipient outcome
branches.decision: Consider confirmation and claim-specific carryover/exposure. Retained tissue protection can be useful without complete drug elimination or permanent repair.

branches.condition: Only systemic recipient or different-article benefit is supported
branches.decision: Keep its route/population separate; no silent completion or conversion of the EVLP-only program.

branches.condition: Interpretable lack of benefit, liability or unattractive economics
branches.decision: Stop or narrow the affected product/financial claim; useful patientcare alone does not establish privately retained return; waiting remains available.

existing_translational_benchmark.title: Regadenoson blinded multicenter donor-lung EVLP trial
existing_translational_benchmark.recipient_denominator_note: One accepted donor pair was split for two single-lung recipients.
existing_translational_benchmark.inference: No statistically significant use/PGD improvement; baseline imbalance, excluded randomized pairs and wide uncertainty prevent a strong universal null. AAT efficacy is not tested by this trial.
